# Width tuning: tune seasons only

*Generated by `backtest.py --tune-width --tune 2022,2023`. Do not edit by hand. The test seasons were not read.*

Every setting is scored on the same random draws. **The choice rule:** CRPS first (lower is better; a proper score, so it rewards the right width, not merely a wider one) -- every setting whose CRPS is not measurably worse than the best (paired game-block 95% interval reaching zero) is a **tie**; among the ties, the **width** closest to 0.20 (the share of outcomes outside the model's p10-p90) wins. Receiving settings are scored on receptions + receiving yards CRPS, each relative to today's sampler; rushing settings on rushing-yards CRPS.
